Body.Content:
Together, voice biometric authentication and fraud detection deliver business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers (note: these two capabilities can be used independently or together). Voice biometric authentication allows organisations to authenticate callers from their voice during natural conversations. It helps improve identity assurance, shortens call durations, reduces customer service rep effort and facilitates secure self-service transactions. At the same time, it helps improve scalability by authenticating callers naturally as they speak. This helps organisations enable consistent, risk-based security across high call volumes without adding authentication friction or process complexity. Fraud detection allows organisations to create fraud watchlists, screen incoming calls and generate real-time alerts when a potential fraud match is detected.

GA date: November CY2026

Preview date: October CY2026
